## Mission

Deliver plan 108 phase 1 — the pij Rust mold — on branch s108/rust-port in worktree /Users/jordanknight/pi-hacking/pij-worktrees/s108-rust-port. This is wave 0 of the pij CLI+daemon Rust port; fs3 plan 001 (fs3-foundations) is the pattern. You build the workspace the whole port is poured into: 8 ratified crates, six frozen ports with shipped fakes, the arch-allowlist drift gate (negative-tested), SQLite/sqlx store skeleton with boot self-migration, queue primitive, hello-depth daemon+cli single binary (pij-rs ping over localhost HTTP + per-boot bearer key), exemplar tests at every tier, rust-toolchain.toml pin, pocs/ spike lane, fixture corpus seeded with real captured pij CLI/wire traffic INCLUDING malformed cases.
